summary.intent: Fix a bug where uploaded files weren't appearing immediately in the file browser, then analyze and plan optimization of the sequential per-file upload pipeline to use parallel batch processing.
summary.outcome: PR #413 created fixing the upload sync trigger and E2E locator issue; Phase 37 added to roadmap for parallel batch upload pipeline; a CodeRabbit review comment about async void callback was also resolved.

repo: Upload flow in useDropUpload.ts is a sequential for...of loop — each file goes through the full encrypt→IPFS pin→FileMetadata IPNS publish→folder update cycle before the next starts.

The SDK's client.uploadFile() does two concurrent operations at the end of each file: publish file IPNS record + updateFolderMetadataAndPublish. The folder IPNS is published N times for N files, but only the last publish matters.
FilePointer indirection chain: FilePointer in folder → IPNS name → resolves to IPFS CID of FileMetadata → contains IPFS CID of encrypted content.
The batch IPNS publish API endpoint already supports arrays; the SDK passes [oneRecord] each time today — batching is an SDK-side change, not an infra change.
IPFS infra has been load-tested at 200 concurrent users, so the team is less constrained by infra limits.
Per-file progress tracking (Phase 36) already supports independent progress updates, making the UI side of parallel uploads already handled.

code.finding: Sequential for...of loop with await on each client.uploadFile() — no parallelism, N IPNS publishes for N files.

onUploadComplete needed to be wired to actions.handleSync for immediate IPNS refresh after upload. Also had an async callback passed where void return was expected — fixed to avoid unhandled rejections.
uploadFile uses Promise.allSettled to concurrently publish file IPNS and update folder metadata, but is called sequentially per file from the web app.
Low-level uploadFile handles encrypt+IPFS upload+FileMetadata creation but not folder updates — folder update happens in the SDK client layer above.

workflow: E2E locators need to exclude upload progress rows using :not(.upload-inline-row) when strict mode is active.
Dev server task kill notifications (exit code 143) from replaced servers are noise — no action needed.
CodeRabbit flagged async void callback anti-pattern — worth watching for this in event handler wiring.

friction: Background dev server task kill notifications created noise (exit 143 from port 5174 after restart on 5173).
Needed multiple rounds of correction to accurately describe the IPFS/IPNS data chain — FileMetadata is an IPFS record pointed to by an IPNS name, not an IPNS record itself.
open_items: Phase 37: Implement parallel batch upload pipeline — SDK needs uploadFiles (plural) method with parallel encrypt+pin, single folder metadata update, and batched IPNS publish. Web app useDropUpload to call the new batch method.
Per-file IPNS batch publish API call: SDK currently passes [oneRecord] arrays; needs to pass all N file records in a single call.
Wall-clock speedup analysis for parallel encrypt+upload not yet measured — expected to be significant for multi-file drops.
